Object and rule: Seven water samples from three sites, each profiled once by viral metagenomics and 16S and 18S rRNA gene amplicons

Key limit: Retained microeukaryote totals need not be equal among samples

Object and rule: High-confidence iPHoP records (score >= 90), classified by whether the named genus is detected in the 16S dataset
n (denominator): 200 records: 127 detected (83 co-detected in a sample), 70 not detected, 3 unresolved
Figures: Fig. 2d; Supplementary Fig. 2c; Supplementary Note 1, Table C

Object and rule: Reference-database CRISPR evidence within high-confidence iPHoP predictions: overall and CRISPR scores >= 90 and an exact same-genus raw spacer hit
n (denominator): 29 (vOTU, genus) edges; 13 co-detected in a sample
Key limit: Part of the iPHoP evidence, not an independent validation; the genus match is exact, not zero-mismatch

Object and rule: Auxiliary metabolic gene candidates; heatmap values are summed TPM of the carrier vOTUs

Key limit: Two carrier definitions; values are not expression or metabolic flux

Object and rule: DefenseFinder anti-defense systems and filtered dbAPIS hits
n (denominator): 106 and 715 vOTUs; 99 in both; 722 in either
Key limit: The tool sets are not additive; the union is at least one candidate, not concordant detection

Object and rule: DefenseFinder NARP1 and NARP2 calls; KO co-occurrence of K03462 and K13522; dbAPIS NARP-targeting hits
Key limit: Operational definitions that are not interchangeable

Object and rule: Virulence-factor hits on CheckV provirus-flagged records, by localization (host region / crossing / viral region)

Object and rule: Four negative-binomial models: all hits with contig-length offset, or hits retained after regional exclusion with retained-length offset; lifestyle labels with or without the CheckV branch (temperate 260 / 244)
Key limit: Regional exclusion changes both the counted hits and the offset; four dependent estimates; labels are annotation-based

Object and rule: Viral windows with defined host flanks, used to calibrate CheckV flagging and trimming
Key limit: Distinct endpoints whose percentages must not be combined; constructs are not natural sequences

Object and rule: Source-labelled Complete Caudoviricetes genomes in 30,079 gene-sharing clusters; 285 metabolic Pfam domains and 38 non-NARP anti-defense profiles, each modelled against log10(CDS)
Key limit: Separate from the local catalogue; carriage associations, not functional demand or causation; clusters are not a phylogeny
